name: Proto-Bantu (family node)
notes: STRUCTURAL ANCESTRY NODE (not a modelled G2P target). Proto-Bantu is the reconstructed ancestor of the Bantu branch of Niger-Congo (Swahili, Zulu and c. 500 other languages). It exists so that the ancestry and phylogenetic-distance metrics of the modern varieties that reference it have a node to resolve to. It carries no grapheme table: the ancestry metrics use only its classification and its ancestor links. A grapheme table needs a cited reconstruction that states its notation and the sound value of each symbol.

sources.author: Nurse, D. & Philippson, G. (eds.)
sources.title: The Bantu Languages
sources.notes: Reference for Bantu reconstruction (structural node only).
